item.title: Foreign leaders, diplomats gather to pay homage to Khaleda Zia

item.title: 2026: A year of hope amid challenges
item.description: As the sun of 2026 rises over Bangladesh, the nation finds itself at a critical crossroads-reflecting on a year of profound transformation while preparing to navigate fresh political, social, cultural, and economic challenges.The new year begins amid heightened political anticipation, with the general election scheduled for February 12. item.title: Jamaat ready to join unity govt: Ameer
item.description: Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr Shafiqur Rahman has indicated the party's willingness to participate in a potential consensus government following the national elections scheduled for February 12.In an interview with an international media outlet on Wednesday, Dr Rahman said that if political parties agree to form a joint government aimed at ensuring at least five years of stability, Jamaat-e-Islami is prepared to take part. item.title: Countries across the globe welcome 2026 with defiance or hope
item.description: From Paris to Dubai to Sydney, crowds began ringing in the new year with exuberant celebrations filled with thunderous fireworks or drumming, while others took a more subdued approach.A countdown to midnight was projected onto the Arc de Triomphe in Paris and Russians celebrated in snowy Moscow. item.title: Mamdani takes over as New York mayor
item.description: Zohran Mamdani, the young upstart of the US left, was sworn in Thursday to take over as New York mayor for a term sure to see him cross swords with President Donald Trump.After the clocks struck midnight, bringing in 2026, Mamdani took his oath of office at an abandoned subway stop to begin managing the United States' largest city.
